functionDeclarations.name: open_in_explorer
functionDeclarations.description: Fast profile only: visibly open a local folder in Windows File Explorer, or show a local file selected in its containing folder. Use this when asked to open/show a folder or locate a file visibly, including 'Songs folder open koro', 'ফোল্ডারটা ওপেন করো', and 'फोल्डर ओपन करो'. Reuse the exact path returned by list_directory, search_files or read_file for follow-ups. Listing or reading a file does not open Explorer. If the path is unknown, discover it or ask; never invent a permission denial. This does not read file contents, play media, execute files or open documents in their associated apps. Completion requires the returned Explorer verification.

path.description: Exact discovered local path, or a standard location such as Desktop, Documents, Downloads or Desktop/Songs.

mode.description: open shows a directory's contents (files are selected in their parent); reveal selects the specified file or folder in its parent.
